title: Experiment graph contract
description: Machine-checkable contract for an OPTIONAL experiments/<id>/graph.yaml. Mirrors architecture/capability.schema.json's own approach: a stdlib-only JSON-Schema subset (validated by scripts/check_architecture.py's validate_against_schema, reused as-is by scripts/check_experiment_graph.py), additive/optional fields so experiments without this file stay valid. `requires`/`blocks` are data-flow edges and participate in the acyclicity check; `evidence_for`/`evidence_against`/`verifier_refs` are back-references and do not (same distinction capability.schema.json already draws between `requires` and `verification_required`).

id.description: This experiment's own id — must match its folder name under experiments/.

parent_ids.description: Experiment ids this branch grew out of. Checked for existence and for cycles alongside requires/blocks.

claim_id.description: Optional finer-grained id if this experiment tracks more than one claim.

mode.description: Lifecycle stage. See docs/experiment-dependency-graph.md for the crosswalk to the two existing, code-unenforced stage concepts (/evolve-solution's 8 stages, research-methodology.md's Research Stage Protocol).

status.description: The single machine-queryable cross-experiment status. Does not replace experiment.yaml's own status or decision.md's Rescue Review Final Status -- see the crosswalk note in experiments/_template/decision.md.

requires.description: Experiment ids that must reach PROMOTED/VERIFIED before this branch can proceed. Data-flow edge -- participates in the acyclicity check.

blocks.description: Experiment ids waiting on this one. Data-flow edge -- participates in the acyclicity check.

evidence_for.description: Experiment/null_result/parked ids this result supports. Back-reference -- does NOT participate in the acyclicity check.

evidence_against.description: Experiment/null_result/parked ids this result weakens or kills. Back-reference -- does NOT participate in the acyclicity check.

artifact_refs.description: Paths to supporting artifacts inside this experiment's own directory. Checked for existence, not for cycles.

verifier_refs.description: Free-text references to who/what verified this branch (e.g. 'skeptic', a specific review's location). Not file-existence-checked -- may name an agent, not a path.

kill_reason.description: Required (non-null) once status = KILLED. Enforced by scripts/check_experiment_graph.py's check_status_conditional_fields, not structurally by this schema -- the validator is a deliberate JSON-Schema subset with no conditional support.

revival_condition.description: Required (non-null) once status = BLOCKED (a 'parked' branch), per the Rescue Review rules in experiments/_template/decision.md -- a real, measurable condition, not 'more data'. NOT required for KILLED: those rules say a 'killed' formulation's path forward is a NEW branch via the Minimal Relaxation Rule, and a 'hard_killed' one can only change on new theorem-level input; in neither case is a stated revival trigger meaningful. This field's description demanded it for KILLED until PR C, which measured that doing so forces authors to invent a fictitious resurrection condition to satisfy a checker.

next_required_test.description: The cheapest differentiating test that would move this branch forward, per the Cheapest Differentiating Test Protocol.

priority_factors.description: OPTIONAL, human-filled 0-1 estimates for the UNVALIDATED Adaptive Promotion Score heuristic. Read by scripts/promotion_score_observer.py in OBSERVE mode only -- never auto-computed, never used to reorder or block anything.
